stable.notes: Tasks is a seventh Activity pane. Capture, schedule, move, and Run now go through the helper to server 6.44.1. The home grid is four-wide so seven tiles stay two rows. Task titles now strip Markdown before truncation and cut on a word boundary. Pairs with server 6.44.1.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
